description:
## Problem
#4455 (merged d8d51e9b59) made ClickBench 0.1 and 10 and Read Primitives 1 and 10 standard scales, and 13 ClickBench bundles became rankable. To keep UAT matrices unchanged, `UAT_UNCERTIFIED_SCALES` in `tests/uat/matrix.py` excludes those scales from the UAT ladders, pruned as `uat.ladder.<benchmark>.scale-not-certified`. Their evidence is generation only (logs in ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/std-scales-20261122/). Users now see standard scales that no UAT stage runs.

## Change
Bring the choice to the owner with cost: per platform cell, the expected run time and memory at each scale. Then either add the UAT cells, run them, and remove the scales from `UAT_UNCERTIFIED_SCALES`; or keep the exclusion and state in the docs which standard scales are not UAT-certified.

## Decision gates
- Owner decides certify or document; no matrix change before that.
- Added UAT time and any live-cloud spend are shown to the owner first; live cloud runs need explicit approval.

## Verification rubric
Pass: either `UAT_UNCERTIFIED_SCALES` is empty and a passing UAT stage run including those cells is linked; or the owner's decision is recorded here and the docs name the uncertified standard scales.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
